executionBinding.rule: immediately before production container create or replacement, docker image inspect the diagnostic tag and require its Id to equal immutableImageId and its org.opencontainers.image.revision label to equal expectedSourceRevision; create the production container by immutableImageId, not by mutable tag; any mismatch is a hard stop

identityBinding.bindingSemantics: server-authoritative logical device identity; physical hardware/browser identity is acceptance evidence, not cryptographic hardware attestation
identityBinding.acceptanceScopeNote: QLL-6 plus its dedicated Chrome profile is the primary production Kiosk identity target only; it does not by itself close the full WO-03 browser/device acceptance matrix.

requiredViewportEvidence: Desktop 1440x900 keyboard operation, focus order, dialog focus return, long task wrapping
Tablet landscape 1024x768 touch controls, status wrapping, offline recovery
Tablet portrait 768x1024 current-next stacking and blocking form under soft keyboard
Mobile 390x844 two-column controls, safe-area, 200 percent zoom, screen-reader announcement
Chromium and Safari Web Locks support comparison plus lease fallback
DevTools offline-online, refresh, two tabs, concurrent start, 409 conflict and 202 reviewRequired visible feedback
requiredOnSiteDeviceEvidence: iPad or on-site tablet opens the explicit resourceId Kiosk URL and fails closed when identity is not configured
landscape and portrait rotation, auto-lock recovery, weak network, offline and reconnect
rapid taps and two-tab contention do not create duplicate facts and non-controller tab is read-only
offline start-block-resume-complete replays in strict order
conflict or reviewRequired stays at queue head without automatic rebase or skip
browser-cache clearing removes only local delivery state and does not change server facts

grouped-session presentation must be executed on the real acceptance device/browser against the exact separately bounded isolated grouped fixture environment; it must display all bound tasks without presenting them as one-task labor time
real screen reader, external keyboard, touch target and studio-lighting contrast checks
operator logout, identity expiry and device handoff flow
wo03AcceptanceMatrix.closureRule: REAL_DEVICE_ACCEPTANCE and OFFLINE_REPLAY_RESULT are post-authorization closure evidence produced from the separately bounded isolated WO-03 acceptance environment with test identity and isolated test data. They are a hard prerequisite before the first production Kiosk run-event write. QLL-6 Chrome remains the primary production Kiosk identity target, but production smoke cannot start until the isolated WO-03 gate passes and no production fact may substitute for the frozen matrix.

isolatedAcceptanceEnvironmentPlan.evidencePurpose: execute the complete frozen WO-03 browser viewport and on-site device matrix with test identity and isolated test data; this environment is the source of REAL_DEVICE_ACCEPTANCE and OFFLINE_REPLAY_RESULT closure evidence
isolatedAcceptanceEnvironmentPlan.coverageRule: every requiredViewportEvidence item and every requiredOnSiteDeviceEvidence item must be executed or observed against the exact bounded isolated environment whenever it depends on authentication, queue state, run state, contention, replay, cache, grouped data, accessibility interaction or device handoff; no production scheduling/run fact may be counted as WO-03 closure evidence

evidenceMapping.REAL_DEVICE_ACCEPTANCE: must be backed by the exact isolated WO-03 environment plus the recorded real device/browser targets
evidenceMapping.OFFLINE_REPLAY_RESULT: must be produced from the isolated test-data replay path, not production run facts
evidenceMapping.PRODUCTION_SMOKE: separate integration evidence only; cannot satisfy or replace WO-03 REAL_DEVICE_ACCEPTANCE or OFFLINE_REPLAY_RESULT

isolationContract: must not mount copy or mutate the production data volume
must not use production Kiosk or role credentials
must not dispatch real DingTalk or other provider notifications
must not mutate production requests scheduling runs reviews receipts audit facts or revisions
must bind an exact test endpoint environment database identity test credential scope device/browser targets and fixture digests before execution

fixtureRequirements.singleItem: one exact test-only single schedule item with one bound test request for normal run/offline/conflict/review flows
fixtureRequirements.groupedItem: one exact test-only grouped_unallocated item with at least two bound test requests for grouped-session presentation
fixtureRequirements.serverFacts: all test fixtures must be reproducible and disposable without sharing production storage

isolatedAcceptanceEnvironmentPlan.failureRule: if the exact isolated environment or any required device/browser/accessibility target is absent or drifts, WO-03 REAL_DEVICE_ACCEPTANCE and OFFLINE_REPLAY_RESULT remain open; do not substitute production smoke writes

productionSmokeWriteGate.rule: PROD-11 may enable the exact production Kiosk configuration and server-authoritative identity before isolated WO-03 execution, but no production run event may be submitted until isolated WO-03 is PASS and KIOSK_EVENT_ATOMIC_CURRENT_SELECTION_CAPABILITY is present and passes inside the same transaction as the event write
productionSmokeWriteGate.failureRule: if isolated WO-03 acceptance is incomplete or fails, keep production event writes at zero and use only the bound Kiosk configuration rollback if production runtime configuration must be disabled

atomicSelectionRequirement.requiredPredicate: inside the same transaction that commits the first production Kiosk run event, re-evaluate the resource-wide current selection for STUDIO-PROD-01 and require the exact frozen acceptance scheduleItemId to be the unique current item with no competing active run or current candidate
atomicSelectionRequirement.getCurrentIsNotAuthority: the preceding authenticated GET /api/v2/kiosk/current is diagnostic and device-facing evidence only; it is not sufficient write authority because another scheduling or run mutation can occur before POST commit
atomicSelectionRequirement.implementationRule: the production event write must fail closed before any production fact if the atomic predicate is unavailable or does not match

/credential/hashBase64.source: scrypt-v1 of the execution generated dedicated Kiosk password using the inserted salt

filePayloadContract.materializationRule: replace both null credential placeholders with the exact generated canonical Base64 values; emit only the exact payload keys above; never copy deployment metadata into the JSON file; validate the final file through loadKioskRuntimeAuthV1 with VIEWER SUBMITTER SCHEDULER and ADMIN credential values supplied only as forbidden comparison inputs before atomic installation

credentialProvisioning.rawPasswordLifecycle: one-time operator-to-device provisioning; if lost, rotate by generating a new credential and config rather than recovering plaintext

databaseWideBriefHostCompatibility.activationRule: fresh-scan every requests_v2.brief_url before PROD-11 authorization/execution; any non-empty brief URL blocks until every observed host is explicitly reviewed and included in allowedBriefHosts

schedulableAcceptanceReadiness.requiredBeforeProd11Request: a separately authorized production scheduling preparation must create or fresh-confirm one exact canonical requests_v2 acceptance request, STUDIO-PROD-01, an active acceptance scheduling configuration whose businessTimeZone is exactly Asia/Shanghai, one canonical proposal acceptance that derives the acceptance schedule item, and the resulting schedule_item_tasks binding from that item to the exact V2 request
schedulableAcceptanceReadiness.canonicalRequestRequirement: the acceptance request must exist in requests_v2 through a bounded canonical materialization path before proposal generation; a V1 snapshot-only request is insufficient
schedulableAcceptanceReadiness.canonicalTaskBindingRequirement: the schedule item must be created through canonical proposal acceptance so schedule_item_tasks binds exactly one acceptance request to the single acceptance schedule item; raw SQL insertion is forbidden
schedulableAcceptanceReadiness.timeZoneBindingRule: the active acceptance scheduling config businessTimeZone must equal Asia/Shanghai exactly, matching the frozen Kiosk auth payload, before proposal generation and must be revalidated before PROD-11 Kiosk event execution

acceptanceItemExecutionWindowContract.authorizationPacketRule: before PROD-11 may be requested, bind an exact planned acceptanceRunStart and acceptanceRunEnd and fresh-prove the same derived schedule item is confirmed, unused, bound only to the exact canonical V2 acceptance request, and covers the whole planned run window with planned_start <= acceptanceRunStart < acceptanceRunEnd <= planned_end
acceptanceItemExecutionWindowContract.authorizationExpiryRule: if current time reaches or passes planned_end before PROD-11 execution starts, or the item becomes used, cancelled, rebound, changed or no longer covers the bound acceptance run window, the authorization packet is stale and PROD-11 must not execute from it
acceptanceItemExecutionWindowContract.executionTimeRecheck: after PROD-11 has enabled the exact production Kiosk auth configuration, but only after the isolated WO-03 productionSmokeWriteGate has passed, immediately before the first production smoke run event fresh-read the same schedule item, schedule_item_tasks binding and production_runs state and require confirmed status, exact STUDIO-PROD-01, exactly one binding to the frozen V2 acceptance request, zero prior runs, planned_start <= current time < planned_end, and planned_end still covers the bound acceptanceRunEnd
acceptanceItemExecutionWindowContract.failureRule: on any execution-time item, binding, run-state or resource-wide current-selection mismatch stop before the Kiosk run event; PROD-11 does not authorize creating or moving a replacement schedule item. Return to a separately authorized scheduling preparation. If Kiosk runtime configuration has already changed, use the bound configuration rollback without erasing production facts.
acceptanceItemExecutionWindowContract.resourceWideSelectionRecheck: after PROD-11 has enabled the exact Kiosk auth configuration, the isolated WO-03 productionSmokeWriteGate has passed, and server-authoritative device identity has been verified, perform authenticated GET /api/v2/kiosk/current?resourceId=STUDIO-PROD-01 and require current.scheduleItemId to equal the frozen derived acceptance item as device-facing evidence; this GET is non-authoritative for the later write and must be followed by the KIOSK_EVENT_ATOMIC_CURRENT_SELECTION_CAPABILITY predicate inside the event transaction
acceptanceItemExecutionWindowContract.selectionConflictRule: any MULTIPLE_CURRENT_CANDIDATES result, any other current scheduleItemId, any other active run exposed as current, a null current item, authentication or identity failure, or any non-success current-read result blocks the run event and forces fail-closed recovery
acceptanceItemExecutionWindowContract.productionEventWriteGate: before the authenticated production current-selection recheck may be followed by any Kiosk run event, require WO03_EXACT_ISOLATED_ACCEPTANCE_ENVIRONMENT_BOUND, WO03_FULL_ISOLATED_VIEWPORT_AND_ON_SITE_MATRIX, REAL_DEVICE_ACCEPTANCE and OFFLINE_REPLAY_RESULT all PASS; otherwise stop with zero production run-event writes

atomicCurrentSelectionGate.transactionBoundary: same transaction as Kiosk production event commit
atomicCurrentSelectionGate.exactScheduleItemPredicate: unique current item equals frozen derived acceptance scheduleItemId and no competing active run or current candidate exists
atomicCurrentSelectionGate.failureRule: absence, race, ambiguity, mismatch, or inability to evaluate the predicate aborts before the event receipt, run/review facts, projection revision, audit, or notification outbox can commit

requiredProductionSmokeEvidence: exact production Kiosk identity binding and authenticated current-read path
exact confirmed unused production acceptance item is the current STUDIO-PROD-01 item immediately before any separately bounded production smoke run event
any production smoke run event is integration evidence only and cannot satisfy WO-03 REAL_DEVICE_ACCEPTANCE or OFFLINE_REPLAY_RESULT
schedulableAcceptanceReadiness.productionSmokeSeparationRule: the separately authorized production scheduling preparation exists only to make an exact bounded production integration smoke possible after PROD-11 enablement; after enablement the complete isolated WO-03 REAL_DEVICE_ACCEPTANCE and OFFLINE_REPLAY_RESULT gates must pass before the first production run event, and production smoke cannot be cited as WO-03 evidence

rollbackContract.beforeAcceptedKioskBusinessFacts: new container may be removed and exact pre-PROD11 container restored if swap/health/identity acceptance fails
rollbackContract.afterAnyAcceptedOrReviewRequiredKioskSub: do not erase business facts; restore pre-PROD11 runtime env without KIOSK_AUTH_CONFIG_PATH, remove Kiosk bind mount, and recreate the service on the PROD11 image with the same volume/port/security topology

requestability.wo03EvidenceSourceRule: REAL_DEVICE_ACCEPTANCE and OFFLINE_REPLAY_RESULT must come from the exact isolated WO-03 acceptance environment; production smoke evidence is separate and non-substitutable
requestability.productionEventWriteGate: no production Kiosk run-event write may commit until isolated WO-03 REAL_DEVICE_ACCEPTANCE and OFFLINE_REPLAY_RESULT are PASS and KIOSK_EVENT_ATOMIC_CURRENT_SELECTION_CAPABILITY revalidates the exact frozen current item inside the same event transaction; the prior GET /current is evidence only and cannot authorize the write

executionImageGate.rule: fresh tag-to-imageId and revision-label equality immediately before container create, then create by immutable imageId; mismatch blocks PROD-11 execution
